Hello, I am Kobita. ] am aclass 7 student of Sundarpur High School. I like
listening to music in my free time. I like folk songs
but 1 don’t understand classical music much.
However, my father likes classical music very much, but
he doesn’t like pop music. He never watches pop musical
programmes on TV. He says he hates them because they
don’t appeal to emotions. My favourite singer is Farida
Parvin. I like her songs very much. She has a wonderful
voice. I also like gardening. I have planted many flowers * '
in my garden. When the flowers are in full bloom, I love
to watch them. I’m very happy about the flowers that I
grow. I just adore them!

C. Now read about Kobita, a class 7 student of Sundarpur village. What
does she say about her likes/dislikes?
Hello, I am Kobita. ] am aclass 7 student of Sundarpur High School. I like
listening to music in my free time. I like folk songs
but 1 don’t understand classical music much.
However, my father likes classical music very much, but
he doesn’t like pop music. He never watches pop musical
programmes on TV. He says he hates them because they
don’t appeal to emotions. My favourite singer is Farida
Parvin. I like her songs very much. She has a wonderful
voice. I also like gardening. I have planted many flowers * '
in my garden. When the flowers are in full bloom, I love
to watch them. I’m very happy about the flowers that I
grow. I just adore them!

like and hate.
